order: Start actual capture/inventory/positive markers before any canary-producing call.
Record each real producer release into case-owned transient scanner ledger; register each actual sink before it can be discarded.
Retain original primary. On every case exit, attempt genuine original cleanup/caller/stop+confirmation drains while capture remains active.
In outer finally scan every registered release against every captured applicable sink and scan late errors, even if setup/assertion/SQL/cleanup failed; mark unavailable/drop/missing-boundary asFAIL.
Attach distinct safe scan/restore/cleanup failures to original safe primary without masking it; verify captured positive markers and real output before wiping.
Restore original descriptors/levels, detach only supplementary collector, reap actual async capture work, wipe buffers. Restore/scan failure makes the case FAIL.

Preserve original object only in transient evidence and export safe class/code/count diagnostic; exact privacy-safe failure reporting vs raw-primary attachment requires independent disposition before authoring. Do not silently replace a product result or claim identity-preserving exported raw failure.
